svg.title: look she on a sorted file of 24 lines: each probe halves the part of the file the first match can be in

g.title: The file: 24 words, sorted, 125 bytes. The first line that begins with "she" could be anywhere: lo = 0, hi = 125, the whole file.
g.text: look she: where is the first line
every line before lo is smaller;
the line at hi, if any, is not

g.title: Probe 1: the middle byte, 62, is inside a line: the probe is the next line, at 64: "is", which is smaller, so the match is after it: lo = 67.
Probe 2: the middle byte, 96, is inside a line: the probe is the next line, at 97: "sherlock", which is a match, so the first match is at it or before: hi = 97.
Probe 3: the middle byte, 82, is inside a line: the probe is the next line, at 86: "seldom", which is smaller, so the match is after it: lo = 93.
Probe 4: no line starts after the middle byte, 95, before hi: the probe is the line at lo, 93: "she", which is a match, so the first match is at it or before: hi = 93.
lo = hi = 93: the search is over after 4 probes. From there look prints every line that begins with "she": "she", "sherlock"; the next line, "the", does not.
